title: Sandwich ELISA on Two Plates, One Washer
notes: The overnight coat is indefinite: the text says to take the plate out when you are ready, so the end is an operator decision, not a clock. Plate 2 is a programStartOffset of 30 minutes and every plate-2 wash that could collide is a compound 'all' on the matching plate-1 wash. Development is fixed at exactly 15 minutes because the acid stop is what defines the step. Three plate-1 washes share the identical sentence and are told apart by occurrence.
